_comment: Descriptive metadata for the Brittain3 49M pilot, served via /api/show.
These are BUILD numbers, not plan numbers. Where the pilot brief and the
actual build disagree, this file records the build. A card that repeats the
plan is worse than no card at all.
This lives beside the checkpoint because the pilot was trained before the
checkpoint payload carried a corpus block. Anything trained from here on
should embed this in the checkpoint instead, where it cannot drift from the
weights. serve.py prefers an embedded block over this file.
purpose: go/no-go pilot for the 181M coding agent; not a release model
_framing_note: NOT optional. Measured on this checkpoint: an unframed prompt returns
'<|file_end|><|repo_end|>' and stops after two tokens, every sample. Every
pretraining document was wrapped this way. serve.py applies it server-side,
so a client that ignores this field still gets working completions.
_languages_note: Share of the code category by collected bytes. Hit exactly; the build report shows zero shortfall on every language.
_mixture_note: Share of COLLECTED bytes across a 4.94GB corpus. Two honest caveats.
1. This is not the brief's 60/15/10/10/5. The four remote categories were
scaled 2.25x after measuring that packing keeps only one ~1000-token
window per document and discards about half of what is collected; the
generated exercises were not scaled with them.
2. Exercises are 1.09% of collected bytes but a larger share of tokens the
model actually trained on, because exercise documents are short enough to
survive windowing whole while large source files are truncated.
_epochs_note: Stage 1 drew 629,145,600 tokens from a 927,110,144-token pool. Under one epoch, so effectively no repetition.
_evaluation_note: BPB is measured WITH framing and with the framing targets masked, at a
512-token window matched to the Brittain2 XS baselines. Unframed, the same
checkpoint reads 1.342 on code — that number measures the prompt format, not
Novice pass@1 rests on 3 correct generations out of 360 and is not a
reliable figure at that sample size.
known_limitations: Solves 2 of 36 novice coding tasks. This is not a usable coding assistant.
Requires document framing; a bare prompt returns nothing.
English costs about 5.9% more tokens than the Brittain2 32k tokenizer.
<|system|> received zero occurrences in pretraining, so its embedding is untrained.
